facts.business: JK Paper Limited manufactures paper and board products including packaging boards, office paper, and specialty paper, and operates paper mills and packaging conversion plants across India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Targets for year 2026-27 have already been finalized and uploaded on EPR portal and collections for this liability will be completed within stipulated time frame.

key_risks: imported inflation due to falling Rupee
pricing pressure due to increase in imports
significant increase in wood costs impacting profitability
facts.related_party_note: Includes amount of Rs. 41.43 Crore recoverable from the Seller Shareholders of Borkar Packaging Private Limited as per the terms of Share Purchase and Shareholder's Agreement (SPSHA)
